goal: Prevent local cross-user RPC credential theft when another process occupies the IPv4 RPC port
Stop bitcoind from failing open and writing RPC cookies when default IPv4 binding fails
reviewability: Author agreed in principle to add error guidance for IPv6-only hosts but has not pushed the update
agreement: Broad concept support for ensuring IPv4 listener matches bitcoin-cli defaults (winterrdog)
Concept approval without detailed reasons (l0rinc, janb84, sedited)
Nonblocking objection: IPv6-only hosts fail startup without clear guidance to set -rpcbind (winterrdog)

categories.name: rpc
why: P1 because it fixes a security issue where bitcoind fails open and leaks RPC cookie credentials
Protects multi-user hosts from rogue local processes capturing plain-text credentials from bitcoin-cli
